name: Kosner
verdict: Owned by Grupo Saltoki (Comercial de Suministros, S.A.). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Brand-origin trivia: the Kosner trademark itself originated in Lyon, France, and the construction-equipment arm joined the French Euromair-Mixer group in 2023, while the HVAC sponsorship sits with Saltoki. Both possible owners are private; no state link either way.
